card.title: 6th NAVAL BRIGADE
card.flavorText: During WWII the Soviet Navy began forming and training Infantry Navy Battalions and around 350,000 Red Navy sailors fought on land in the war. The Naval Infantry conducted over 114 landings, many were also parachute trained, but mostly they served as regular infantry. The 6th Naval Brigade served under the 138th Rifle Division from 1943 and participated in various battles and campaigns on the Eastern Front.
